models_evaluated: machine learning recommender for tailoring motivational text messages

links.outcome: 6-month self-reported 7-day point prevalence smoking cessation, ML recommender vs standard messaging
links.effect: No significant difference: 35.4% (146/412) ML recommender vs 40.1% (156/389) standard; adjusted OR 0.81 (95% CI 0.61-1.08).
links.quote: There was no significant difference in 6-month smoking cessation between ML recommender (146 of 412 participants [35.4%] with outcome data) and standard messaging (156 of 389 participants [40.1%] with outcome data) groups (adjusted odds ratio, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.61-1.08).

unlisted_practices: viral peer-recruitment tool kit to improve smoking cessation outcomes

screen.reason: This is an empirical RCT evaluating a machine learning recommender system for tailoring motivational text messages directly delivered to patients/participants for smoking cessation.
